name: task
description: Run background work: LLM chains or multi-agent team tasks. Use action 'chain' to run a sequence of LLM calls (e.g. generate then transform). Use action 'launch' for multi-agent team delegation. NOT for simple one-shot LLM calls — use the llm tool for that.

action.description: Action to perform. Use 'chain' for sequential LLM pipeline, 'launch' for team task.

steps.description: Ordered list of LLM steps for chain action. Each step has tier, prompt, and optional system. Use {result} in prompt to inject previous step's output.

tier.description: LLM tier name to use for this step.

prompt.description: Prompt for this step. Use {result} to reference previous step's output.

team.description: Team name to run with (optional, enables multi-agent)

need_validation.description: Require user approval before execution (default false)
